title:
Epic for handling asset onboarding export specific workflows.
This epic listens for job completion events and handles the specific
business logic for asset onboarding export jobs, including:
- Downloading ZIP files when export jobs complete
- Showing appropriate banners for different job states (success, failure, running)
- Managing filename storage and cleanup for export operations

Payload format for actions:
- `GLOBAL_WORKFLOW_COMPLETED_BANNER`: `{ jobId: string }` - Job completed successfully
- `GLOBAL_WORKFLOW_FAILED_BANNER`: `{ jobId: string }` - Job failed or was canceled
name: AssetOnboardingExportEpic
